page.layout: One column of text on the right-hand part of the scan, with a woodcut ornament band above the heading; a faint show-through of another page (ghost text "Lectori S." and other lines) is not transcribed. No marginal notes. Printed page number not visible.

main_text.head: LECTORI S.
main_text.p: ECcas tibi denuò, Amice Lector, animadversi-ones, ut jam antea monui, absq; omni studio partium, ruri exaratas, ut exipsosty-lo vel primo senties intui-tu, in Libros Novi Te-stamenti, quâ potui curâ à mendis repurgatas, & in gratiam tuam quàm licuit breviter contractas. Mul-

page.notes: Initial E is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "ccas". Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored. The word "Ccas" is printed with a small capital C and is copied as printed. Catchword-like word "ta" at the foot right is the continuation of "Multa", treated as a line.
